stone.name: Svetlana
stone.biography: Svetlana is a pale marble stone who loves singing loudly on a windowsill, especially early in the morning.

events.eventNotes: Svetlana was admitted to Pebble Haven and made available for adoption.
Shelter staff observed that Svetlana sings loudly on the windowsill every morning at 05:00 local time (Asia/Tbilisi). She enjoys singing there, especially early in the morning.
First neighbor complaint: Svetlana's loud singing on the windowsill at 05:00 disturbed the neighbors. The neighbors generally dislike loud sounds.

Second neighbor complaint: Svetlana again sang loudly on the windowsill at 05:00. The neighbors objected to the early-morning noise. This was the second recorded incident involving her singing and the neighbors.

profile.preferredEnvironment: A windowsill for singing, especially early in the morning.
